data.description:
Minamoto no Raikou - Heroic Spirit from Fate/Grand Order. Lancer-class Servant for summer event. AKA: Minamoto no Yorimitsu

- Dreamed of motherhood but faced constant psychological torture by her father, who forbade her from being a woman or mother. Behind one of the Minamoto Clan’s greatest heroes lies a deeply broken and abused woman.
- Previously summoned to Chaldea, where she became a strong ally. In response to summer’s advent and to prevent more lewd activities, Raikou has undergone a Class change after prayer to Gozu-Tennou! She has become a dedicated warrior who protects Chaldea from immoral behavior.
- Appears as Sanzang’s teammate in ‘Dead Heat Summer Race.’ Uses a cart pulled by two horses, Kyōgoku and Bai Long, as her racing vehicle.
